BiblicalUsage: Pethen is the asp, the venomous serpent, named for its coiling. The psalm promises that the one who dwells in the secret place will tread upon the lion and the adder, Isaiah pictures a child playing safely on the hole of the asp in the peace of God's kingdom, and Job says the wicked man sucks the poison of asps.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the asp is sin's picture in the Bible: small, coiled, and deadly, yet under the feet of the one God keeps, and disarmed in the day of His peace.
